primitive.relation: strong edge colouring, in stages; stage 1 migrates U5's total symmetric pair palette to Chromatic.foundations.strong_pair_palettes, by conversion: U5.diff_edge x y u v is distinct_edge_pairs x y u v (the unordered pairs {x, y} and {u, v} differ), U5.near_edge x y u v is near_edge_pairs x y u v (the eight disjuncts x = u, x = v, y = u, y = v, x -- u, x -- v, y -- u, y -- v) and U5.strong_edge_colourable G k is strong_pair_colourable G k (a map on ALL ordered vertex pairs into 'I_k, symmetric, separating two host edges whose pairs are distinct and near, the guards in this order). No nonemptiness, edge or palette guard: at k = 0 it holds exactly on the empty host, an edgeless nonempty host needs 0 < k, two near distinct edges need two colours, and the palette bound is monotone. Later classes of this family, not migrated here and not identified with this one: X43's chromatic number of the square of its line graph (deferred, same normalized name; it needs a parent with A25) and XE1's exact edge-set palette with its edgeless k = 0 clause and index (cross-name). No line-graph equivalence is asserted.

total-symmetric-pair-palette.note: strong_pair_colourable G k: a symmetric map on all ordered vertex pairs into 'I_k separating two host edges with distinct near pairs; the U5 row (0 < Delta G, the odd / even bound) is frozen over it, one whole iff.

unordered-pair-distinction.note: distinct_edge_pairs x y u v: neither x = u, y = v nor x = v, y = u.

near-pairs.note: near_edge_pairs x y u v: the eight disjuncts, a shared vertex or an adjacent pair of endpoints.

line-graph-square.note: chi([set: graph_power (x43_line_graph G) 2]) <= k: a chromatic number on the square of X43's local line graph, true at every k on edgeless hosts where the pair palette needs 0 < k on a nonempty host; deferred to a later class stage on a parent with A25 (which freezes this helper and X43's row) and its pre-M1 + A1 whole Original; no bridge claimed here.

upstream_audit.note: D13 discovery (evidence/D13-strong-edge-discovery/upstream-search.txt): the pinned coq-graph-theory has no strong edge colouring, induced matching, graph power, edge colouring or chromatic index (its mgraph.line_graph is the directed line digraph of a multigraph); GTBase's multigraph line_graph / chromatic_index and the proper-edge-colouring canonical have no distance-two clause. The pair palette is a Chromatic foundations module, not re-exported.
